name: timeline-path
title: Timeline Path
author: AlgorizeTech
description: Ask the user to pick one of 6 animated timeline variants: https://avaraui.com/view/animated-timeline. This is the Path timeline. Skip the question if the user already named one. A scroll-linked timeline on a winding path that draws itself from stop to stop, with a glowing head and cards that light up as it arrives. Use it for a company or product milestone story.
docs: Named exports: TimelinePathBlock (also uses timeline-kit-theme.ts and timeline-scroll.ts, which install alongside). Items take { id, title, date?, description?, icon? }. The path winds between two lanes from a 640px column up and hugs the left edge below that. It follows the scroll of its nearest scrolling ancestor, else the page. Zero runtime dependencies.
